independent_oracle_review: tools/test_interaction_case_inside.py recomputes every selected case with integer comparisons and a linear search: an unsigned comparison reads both operands as unsigned values and a signed one reads both as signed (11.8.1, 11.8.2), an item value uses ==? with right-side wildcards (11.4.6), a range uses >= and <=, an item matches only on 1 (12.5.4), a plain case stops at the first match and a unique0-case never matches more than one item for the chosen inputs (12.5.3).

array_item_probe.expected_stdout:
A u=111 array=0
A u=111 value=0
B u=011 array=1
B u=011 value=1
array_item_probe.reading: A 2-bit signed array element 11 meets a 3-bit unsigned case expression, so the comparison is unsigned and the element is zero-extended to 011: 111 selects default and 011 selects the item, for the array as for the same value written as an item.

A u=111 value=0

fault_injection.method: Each mutant changes one rule of the reference model while the case expressions stay those that the reference chose; the count is the selected cases with a changed selected item, case expression call count or counting item observation. Mutants are not suite tests.

mutants.mutant: an X result taken as a match
items extended by their own sign instead of the joint type
operands of the wildcard comparison swapped
unknown item bits read as zero
counting item called after an earlier match
case expression evaluated again for each compared item

note: This probe and these mutants are qualification evidence, not extra suite tests or pass records.
